review_candidates.title: Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer Consultant
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or A
eligibility_evidence: Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Flexible working arrangements (office, home, client sites) and international project exposure.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real. Qualifications What you bring Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a production environment. Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or similar.
